title: Prayer Journal: Prompts, Templates and How to Start
description: Start a prayer journal with free prayer journal prompts, printable templates, examples, Bible journaling ideas and our Prayer Journal for Women app.
intro: A prayer journal is a place to write your prayers, the verses that speak to you, and the ways God answers. Start with a free template, a list of prompts, or a guide for your season of life.

blocks.p: Writing slows your thoughts down so you can actually pray them. It keeps your mind from wandering, gives you a list of people to remember, and leaves a record of answered prayers that builds your faith when you read it back.
Begin with the [prayer journal template](/prayer-journal-template/) or read [how to start a prayer journal](/how-to-start-a-prayer-journal/).

sections.h2: Ways to keep a prayer journal

blocks.p: Some people follow a simple pattern like [ACTS](/prayer-journal-acts/) (adoration, confession, thanksgiving, supplication). Others start in Scripture with the SOAP method in [how to journal the Bible](/how-to-journal-the-bible/). You can also keep a prayer list by person, with pages for your [husband](/prayer-journal-for-husband/), your [children](/prayer-journal-for-your-children/) or your [future husband](/prayer-journal-for-your-future-husband/).

If you want a guided year, our [Prayer Journal for Women](/prayer-journal-for-women/) app gives you a verse, a reflection and a prayer page every week, with a prayer list and a record of answered prayers.
